fichas.title: Drive-in cinemas
fichas.summary: Drive-in cinema layouts use curved, sloping ramps to raise the front of cars and maintain rear-seat sightlines to the screen. The page describes site access, ticketing, screen placement and construction, projection facilities, in-car sound, heating, and supporting amenities. A fan-shaped layout and a double-screen arrangement are illustrated.
uses: Screen films to audiences seated in cars
Provide vehicle access, ticket checking, and circulation
Provide sound and optional heating to parked cars

fichas.title: Double drive-in cinema
fichas.summary: The illustrated double cinema serves two screens from one projection room, allowing staggered starting times. Shared facilities include cash desks, a bar, and toilets; the plan also shows separate projection surfaces, car ramps, waiting areas, and a central entrance and ticket office.
uses: Show films on two screens, with the option of staggered starting times
Share support facilities between both cinema areas
figure_refs: 3 Double cinema. One projection room for both screens, with the possibility of staggered starting times. All other areas (cash desks, bar, toilets etc.) are common
